title: Compose — Draft Alternative — Output Schema (compose-draft-alternative)
description: Output schema for sprk_analysisaction sprk_actioncode='compose-draft-alternative' (spaarkeai-compose-r2 task 042, FR-09). MIRRORS VERBATIM the outputSchema baked into infra/dataverse/actions/compose-draft-alternative.action.json (the systemPrompt/schema author surface). The STRUCTURED-EDIT PAYLOAD (adeu Pattern §6.1) that becomes the opaque SessionOutput.Payload written under the `compose` disposition before render (ADR-040). Azure OpenAI Structured Outputs compatible: additionalProperties:false, object-level required array, no anyOf/oneOf/discriminator; match_mode is a closed set via the `enum` keyword (NOT a property-level boolean required, which is FORBIDDEN).
$comment-required: Object-level required array only — property-level boolean 'required' is FORBIDDEN (OpenAiFunctionSchemaValidator). match_mode's closed set is expressed via the `enum` keyword.

target_text.description: The exact substring of the current clause the edit replaces — copied VERBATIM from selectionText so the editor can locate it. The whole selection when rewriting it as a unit.

new_text.description: The proposed replacement clause language — self-contained, drafting-ready contract prose (no placeholders, no commentary, no markup). Inserted as a pending track-change.

match_mode.description: How the editor locates target_text: 'strict' (replace the whole selection — default), 'first' (first occurrence of a fragment), or 'all' (every occurrence, e.g. a defined-term change).

rationale.description: Concise plain-language explanation of WHY this alternative is better (≤1 short paragraph, ≤1500 chars) — names the concrete improvement, not a generic justification.

sources.description: Grounding for the proposal — each entry is { type, id, snippet }. Empty array when the retrieval layer supplied no grounding — never fabricated.

id.description: The retrieval-layer identifier for the source — never fabricated.

snippet.description: A SHORT supporting excerpt from the source.
